entries.title: Demo loads with ad blockers
items: The guided demo against bots now loads even if you use an ad blocker or a privacy browser like Brave — no more getting stuck at 5%.

entries.title: Crisp welcome art on big screens
items: The welcome screen art is now crisp and sharp, even on a big TV.

entries.title: Your demo guide now speaks
items: In the guided demo against the bots, your guide now has a full voice, speaking all of its lines out loud in English and Greek.
Fixed the Detective's English introduction, which repeated "each night".

entries.title: The final sound is in
items: Palermo Noir now plays its final sound throughout — the real music, sound effects and background ambience, with the old placeholder sounds gone.

Voices are now the final recordings, and more moments speak than before: each role is introduced as the cards are dealt, "Dawn is coming" before the first night ends, a call when the town is ready to vote and when voting closes, a reminder to join while you wait in the lobby, and the host's pause and resume.
Each phase now plays a full song that loops — in the lobby, the deal, night, day, voting and the finish — instead of a short repeating clip.

Key moments now play their sound to the end before the game moves on — the sunrise, for one, stays on screen until its sound finishes — and the winners' theme plays in full at the end instead of being cut off.

entries.title: Lawyer's powers open smoothly
items: The Lawyer's powers now open with a smooth animation — the form grows and fades in under the card, and closes a touch faster, instead of snapping open.

entries.title: New seafront welcome screen
items: The welcome screen now shows new seafront artwork, sized to look right on both your phone and a shared TV.

entries.title: Demo loads reliably
items: The demo now opens as soon as it's ready, instead of getting stuck on the welcome screen.

entries.title: The guided demo is live
items: Play a whole game of Palermo Noir in your browser, alone at a table of bots, with nothing to install and no account.
Pick one of the 14 roles or Surprise me, a table of 6, 8 or 10, English or Greek, and the short demo (about six minutes) or a full game (about fifteen).
A guide stops the game at each new moment to show you what to tap, and why; Chapters, Back, 2× speed and Behind the scenes help you follow it.
